# `/account-requests` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /account-requests/v1/deletion

`getAccountDeletionRequestsV1` — List of Account Deletion Requests

Retrieves a paginated list of account deletion requests filtered by the provided query parameters. When the "mine" parameter is set to true, the response includes only those deletion requests that were initiated by the currently authenticated user. If "mine" is false or not specified, the endpoint returns all account deletion requests associated with the current tenant, regardless of the initiator. This allows both users and administrators to view relevant deletion requests based on their…

- Scopes: idn:account-requests:management, idn:account-requests:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, USER
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `mine` (query) — default False — Determines whether to return only the account deletion requests initiated by the currently authenticated user. If set to true, the response includes only deletion requests created by the logged-in…
- Returns 200: array of accountactionrequestdto

### POST /account-requests/v1/account/{accountId}/delete

`deleteAccountRequestV1` — Delete account

Initiates an account deletion request for the specified account. This method validates the input data, processes the deletion request, and generates an asynchronous result containing a tracking ID. >**NOTE: You can only delete accounts from sources of the "Connected" type. which supports account deletion**

- Scopes: idn:account-requests:create
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, USER
- Parameters:
  - `accountId` (path, required) — Account ID.
- Body (application/json): accountdeleterequestinput
- Returns 202: accountrequestasyncresult

### POST /account-requests/v1/machine-account-create

`createMachineAccountRequestV1` — Submit Machine Account Creation Request — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Initiates machine account creation request for the specified subtype. This method validates the input data, processes the machine account creation request, and generates an asynchronous result containing a tracking ID. >**NOTE: You can only request a machine accounts on subtype for which you have a create machine account entitlement provisioned.**

- User levels: USER
- Body (application/json): machineaccountcreaterequestinput
- Returns 202: accountrequestasyncresult

### GET /account-requests/v1/machine-account-create/{accountRequestId}

`getCreateMachineAccountRequestV1` — Get Machine Account Creation Request — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Retrieves a account request details for machine account creation. This allows the user to view all details for given account request.

- User levels: USER
- Parameters:
  - `accountRequestId` (path, required) — Account Request ID
- Returns 200: accountrequestdetailsdto

### POST /account-requests/v2/machine-account-create

`createMachineAccountRequestV2` — Submit Machine Account Creation Request — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Submits a machine account creation request on the account-requests API. This operation accepts the same request and runs the same creation process as [Create Machine Account](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/create-machine-account-v-2). Use this operation when the integration already calls the account-requests APIs. New integrations should call [Create Machine Account](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/create-machine-account-v-2). This method validates the input data, processes…

- User levels: USER
- Body (application/json): machineaccountcreaterequestinputv2
- Returns 202: accountrequestasyncresult
